message: 《DeepSeek 鲸鱼娘厨房偷吃白米饭被抓》30 秒 POV 喜剧分镜定稿（revision 4，6 镜）：setup 厨房踮脚扒饭 + 左上角碳水采样进度条 0%→67%；inciting_incident 反打过肩、敲桌两下、瞳孔变加载圈；panic_reaction 两镜 1.5 倍速狂扒饭、米粒糊镜头、主人画外索要“Put it back.”；punchline 站直装正经，原样说出角色口头禅并接“Semantic integrity: verified.”呼应气泡；tag 主人画外吐槽、她弹米粒眨眼推开镜头、DeepSeek 风格浮窗写“采样完成 300g”+底部日志条。总时长 29.9s，beat 时间全部在 ±0.5s 容差内，规则、引用、制作字段、brief 覆盖检查均通过。人工复核项：S6 使用 DeepSeek 品牌界面风格需确认使用权；台词“...and she's gotten fatter again.”含身材评价，需确认对目标受众是否合适；audio_notes.sfx[4]（主人低声画外音、不露脸）文字重合度偏低，请确认实际呈现。

model_review.summary: 画面和道具连续性非常扎实，压缩也基本合理；但 punchline 里最好笑的那句被整段替换，屏幕上的"Semantic Integrity Check"再没有台词回应，且 S4 只有一句台词却空转了 5 秒、全程没有"把饭还回来"的正面冲突，导致升级感和收尾笑点都掉了一档。
strengths: 视觉描述极其可执行：3000K 暖光、镜头尺寸、手持晃动、米粒打在镜头上、鲸鱼鳍发饰歪掉、肚子微鼓、嘴边两粒米，模型可以直接照着生成
AI 术语隐喻（cache cleaning / viscosity / training data）与角色设定高度一致，"carbohydrate cache"到 tag 的"just cache"有清晰的回扣结构
角色口头禅在 S5 原样保留，delivery 标注（muffled / innocent and smug）让配音有明确指令
chopsticks 停在半空 + 瞳孔变成 loading 圈的冻结反应，是很好的免费反应镜头

character_setting.name: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
character_setting.appearance: Blue and white gradient ponytail, a small whale fin accessory on top of her head, a loose home-style T-shirt with the DeepSeek logo on the bottom hem, barefoot, rice grains often stuck to the corners of her mouth
character_setting.personality: Greedy and extremely quick to react; when caught she instantly switches to an innocent yet smug mode while still chewing, faces the camera (the owner), acts cute and stays stubborn
character_setting.catchphrase: No, I didn't steal it! This is carrying out a carbohydrate sampling mission!

script_structure.visual: POV walks into the kitchen. In the center of the frame an electric rice cooker is steaming. The Whale Maiden stands behind the counter with her back to the camera, on tiptoe, holding a large bowl and shoveling a big ball of white rice into her mouth with chopsticks; her cheeks puff out like a hamster's. Hearing footsteps she tilts her head slightly but does not turn around and keeps chewing hard.
script_structure.audio: (chewing sound: 'ba-jie ba-jie')... Ah! The viscosity parameter has exceeded the limit... Take another bite for sampling--

script_structure.visual: POV freezes. The owner's hand enters from the right and taps the dining table twice. The Whale Maiden's whole body freezes, chopsticks suspended in the air. She slowly turns her head toward the camera; her pupils tremble and the food in her mouth is not yet swallowed.
script_structure.audio: (two taps on the table: 'dong, dong') / Whale Maiden: '... (gulp)'

script_structure.visual: The Whale Maiden faces the camera and frantically scoops the rest of the bowl into her mouth. Playback speeds up 1.5x and rice grains splash onto the lens. Her cheeks bulge to the limit, her T-shirt collar catches rice grains, and her eyes keep pleading with you. The camera is slightly handheld and shakes as the owner steps back.
script_structure.audio: (fast swallowing + chopsticks hitting the bowl) No, no! You didn't see anything!! This is cache cleaning! Carbohydrate cache!! (unclear)

script_structure.visual: The Whale Maiden swallows the last mouthful and stands up straight facing the camera: two rice grains on her lips, hair accessory tilted, hands behind her back trying to look dignified, belly visibly bulging a little. She clears her throat and smiles at the camera.
script_structure.audio: (clears throat) Cough. I'm just checking the semantic integrity of the rice. The DeepSeek taste model requires a large amount of training data, you know. Don't look at me like that.

script_structure.visual: POV sighs (off screen). A floating window styled like the DeepSeek UI pops up above the Whale Maiden's head: 'Carbohydrate sampling completed ✅ Sample quantity: 300g'. She flicks the rice grains off her mouth with a fingertip, winks at the camera, then gently pushes the camera away with her hand.
script_structure.audio: (owner, off screen: '...and she's gotten fatter again.') / Whale Maiden: 'This is just cache... Go away!' / (boop~ sound effect)

visual_notes: Color: warm yellow kitchen light contrasted with the Whale Maiden's cool blue and white; in POV shots the background behind her is blurred.
In the speed-up section rice grains smear directly onto the lens, breaking the fourth wall.
When she is caught, the highlights in her eyes turn into rotating circles to stress that she is an AI.
At the end the push on the camera briefly blurs the picture to simulate physical contact.
The UI floating window overlays a DeepSeek-style chat bubble on the POV picture.
text_overlay_hints: 0-5s: progress bar in the upper left, 'Carbohydrate Sampling in Progress...' 0% -> 67%
9-20s: flashing at the bottom, 'Emergency Swallow Protocol Activated 3.2 times per second'
20-26s: bubble above her head, 'Generating Excuses...' -> 'Semantic Integrity Check'
26-30s: bottom center, 'DeepSeek Whale Maiden · Daily Sampling Log'
camera_notes: The main camera is first-person POV throughout; the viewer is the protagonist (the owner). Hands in frame show the protagonist's actions; the protagonist's face is never shown.
Occasionally cut to a reverse shot of the Whale Maiden from the protagonist's position.
